claims.text: In Abuja, a yearly tenancy requires half a year (six calendar months) notice to quit.
The full statutory period must fall between service and the stated expiry under the Recovery of Premises Act.
An agent or solicitor needs written authority before issuing a valid notice in Abuja.
Under s.7, a written notice of intention to recover possession giving not less than seven days must follow.

threads.text: In Abuja, a yearly tenant gets 6 full calendar months notice to quit, not 3 months. An agent or solicitor needs written authority before issuing a valid notice in Abuja. Then a 7-day notice of owner's intention must follow after it expires. Did your landlord serve you 6 full months?
threads.evening: In Abuja, the date of service is what counts on a notice to quit. The full statutory period must run from the day it reaches your hands.
